sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report concerns customer C11923 and payment card C11923-K2. On 2016-12-29 at 03:27:44, an online purchase of $131.30 (transaction 3583368) was charged to this card. The cardholder explicitly denied making this transaction. The charge originated from device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M with Chrome 66.0 for Android, which is marked as new to customer C11923's account and has never before been used on card C11923-K2. Within 24 hours, the identical device profile was used to conduct additional online transactions: $125.72 charged to connected card C03938-K1 and $125.59 charged to connected card C05595-K1, both marked as suspicious. This activity pattern is consistent with card-not-present fraud conducted from a new device, a known fraud methodology used to circumvent standard verification controls. Customer C11923's account history shows 10 confirmed fraud cases among 11 total closed cases, indicating substantial account risk. In response to these findings, card C11923-K2 has been blocked to prevent further unauthorized activity, connected cards C03938-K1 and C05595-K1 have been placed under enhanced monitoring, and a formal investigation case has been created. This report is filed pursuant to Policy R2 based on customer denial of the transaction combined with the shared device profile that links multiple cards to suspicious activity.
